reinstall_modal.title: Reinstall AI Assistant?
reinstall_modal.description: This will recreate the AI Assistant container with GPU support enabled. Your downloaded models will be preserved. The service will be briefly unavailable during reinstall.
reinstall_modal.success: AI Assistant is being reinstalled with GPU support. This page will reload shortly.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Advanced configuration for operators. These settings are optional — the defaults work for most deployments.
advanced.connectivity_desc: NOMAD periodically checks whether it can reach the internet. By default it probes Cloudflare's utility endpoint with a few fallbacks. Set a custom endpoint below if your network blocks the defaults. Leave blank to use the built-in defaults.
advanced.env_override_message: The INTERNET_STATUS_TEST_URL environment variable is set and takes precedence over this setting. Remove it to manage the test URL here.
advanced.test_url_help: A single http(s) URL used to check connectivity. Any HTTP response counts as online.
advanced.validation_protocol: Test URL must use http or https.
advanced.validation_invalid: Test URL must be a valid URL (e.g. "https://example.com").
advanced.save_error: There was an error updating the setting. Please try again.

support.title: Support the Project
support.subtitle: Project NOMAD is 100% free and open source — no subscriptions, no paywalls, no catch. If you'd like to help keep the project going, here are a few ways to show your support.
support.kofi_desc: Every contribution helps fund development, server costs, and new content packs for NOMAD. Even a small donation goes a long way.
support.rogue_title: Need Help With Your Home Network?
support.rogue_desc: Rogue Support is a networking consultation service for home users. Think of it as Uber for computer networking — expert help when you need it.
support.star_github_desc: — it helps more people discover NOMAD
support.word_of_mouth: Share NOMAD with someone who'd use it — word of mouth is the best marketing
support.join_discord_desc: — hang out, share your build, help other users

legal.privacy_intro: Project NOMAD is designed with privacy as a core principle:
legal.privacy_telemetry_desc: NOMAD does not collect, transmit, or store any usage data, analytics, or telemetry.
legal.privacy_local_desc: All your data, downloaded content, AI conversations, and notes remain on your device.
legal.privacy_accounts_desc: NOMAD operates without user accounts or authentication by default.
legal.privacy_network_desc: An internet connection is only required to download content or updates. All installed features work fully offline.
legal.content_disclaimer_p1: Project NOMAD provides tools to download and access content from third-party sources including Wikipedia, Wikibooks, medical references, educational platforms, and other publicly available resources.
legal.content_disclaimer_p2: Crosstalk Solutions, LLC does not create, control, verify, or guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of any third-party content. The inclusion of any content does not constitute an endorsement.
legal.content_disclaimer_p3: Users are responsible for evaluating the appropriateness and accuracy of any content they download and use.
legal.medical_disclaimer_p1: Some content available through NOMAD includes medical references, first aid guides, and emergency preparedness information. This content is provided for general informational purposes only.
legal.medical_disclaimer_warning: This information is NOT a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
legal.medical_disclaimer_li1: Always seek the advice of qualified health providers with questions about medical conditions.
legal.medical_disclaimer_li2: Never disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking it because of something you read in offline content.
legal.medical_disclaimer_li3: In a medical emergency, call emergency services immediately if available.
legal.medical_disclaimer_li4: Medical information may become outdated. Verify critical information with current professional sources when possible.
legal.data_storage_intro: All data associated with Project NOMAD is stored locally on your device:
legal.data_storage_docker_volumes: Stored in Docker volumes on your local system
legal.data_storage_outro: You maintain full control over your data. Uninstalling NOMAD or deleting these directories will permanently remove all associated data.
